# Origin UI components from 21st.dev

The recipe path mounts [Stepper](https://21st.dev/@originui/components/stepper) (catalog item 774) and [Popover](https://21st.dev/@originui/components/popover) (397), both by Origin UI. Both TSX files contain the componentCode returned by the authenticated 21st.dev catalog on November 27, 2026. The build compiles these files into the client. The project supplies the class-name helper, styles, live recipe data and logo children. Selection indicates inspection of a planned step. The website runs no recipe tools.
